question: Can an independently learned causal law A survive B interference and cold restore, then reduce the public-evidence cost of unsignaled return to A against the strongest equally-informed control?
hypothesis: Retained learned context should recover A with strictly lower prospective observation/action cost without weakening reward or prediction against fully-fitted correctly specified controls; ties or losses are negative.

engineering_only.cold_restore: Compare identical pre-B public queries after process restore; a matching serialized checkpoint alone is insufficient.
engineering_only.arm_parity: Require identical ordered public tapes and action opportunities for all compared arms. Report interventions, fitting and validation evidence, compute, bytes, process time and memory.
engineering_only.test_data: Fabricated manually written unit tuples only; no original or prospective scientific world outcomes and no reuse of NCI05 or D256 cohorts.
engineering_only.allowed_outcome: Engineering guard test qualification only; not source authenticity, causal identification, control-fit proof or science.

proposed_science_design.identity: Separate future source-pinned sealed manifest is MANDATORY before any scientific first use. This proposal does NOT reserve seeds, authorize source first use or freeze final primary.
proposed_science_design.regimes: Independently learned A and B with unannounced A-to-B-to-A switches; no externally supplied boundary, phase, source or reset label; test genuinely unfamiliar context-conditioned causal operators, not only known two-rule identity.
proposed_science_design.fairness: All non-oracle arms see exactly the same cumulative public tape, ordered action opportunities, source foundation, byte/slot and action budgets; evaluate matched-compute subset and stronger unrestricted controls separately. Counterfactual outcomes only for evaluator, never learners.
proposed_science_design.evidence: Evaluator may know law/source identity for scoring only; source IDs, switches and outcomes withheld from learner until public consequences occur. Pre-evidence identifiability limits must be included.

proposed_thresholds.false_alarm_regression: no increase vs strongest validated change-point control
proposed_thresholds.decision: Prospective scientific gain requires all criteria across >=3/4 genuinely unfamiliar independent families, independent reproduction and native owner acceptance; incomplete=>UNVERIFIED, negative=>NO_GO.

preregistration_note: This is a design and source-free engineering preflight freeze. It is NOT a final confirmatory preregistration; no protected or primary evidence may be generated until all manifest and custody blockers are closed before first use.
